primarySources.title: NVIDIA Corp. Form 8-K (Items 2.02 & 9.01: Q3 FY27 Financial Results Furnished Exhibits)
primarySources.verbatimExcerpt: Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition. On November 17, 2026, NVIDIA Corporation, or the Company, issued a press release announcing its results for the quarter ended October 25, 2026. The press release is attached as Exhibit 99.1 and is incorporated herein by reference. Attached hereto as Exhibit 99.2 and incorporated by reference herein is financial information and commentary by Colette M. Kress, Interim Chief Executive Officer, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of the Company, regarding results for the quarter ended October 25, 2026, or the CFO Commentary. Attached hereto as Exhibit 99.3 and incorporated by reference herein is supplemental financial information for the quarter ended October 25, 2026.

primarySources.title: NVIDIA Corp. Form 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (Q3 FY27 Earnings Release $115,844M, Financial Statements & Q4 FY27 Outlook $130.0B +/- 3%)
primarySources.verbatimExcerpt: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported revenue for the third quarter ended October 25, 2026, of $115.8 billion ($115,844 million), up 20% from the previous quarter and up 103% from a year ago. GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 74.8% ($86,676 million gross profit) and 74.9% ($86,724 million), respectively. GAAP net income was $65,287 million ($2.70 diluted EPS); non-GAAP net income was $64,870 million ($2.68 diluted EPS). GAAP operating cash flow was $48,253 million; free cash flow was $43,777 million. Outlook for the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027, which includes an additional week: Revenue is expected to be $130.0 billion, plus or minus 3%. NVIDIA is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its outlook. GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be between 71.0% and 72.0%. GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $11.0 billion and $10.7 billion, respectively. Ramped production and began shipping NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 with racks running at partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and Nebius. Expanded the Vera Rubin cloud ecosystem, announcing general availability of Vera Rubin NVL72 systems and Vera CPUs on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, general availability of Google Cloud's Vera Rubin-powered A5X instances. Expanded Anthropic's access to NVIDIA Grace Blackwell and Vera Rubin capacity through cloud providers. Announced an agreement to acquire Hugging Face to scale its platform and make intelligence more open, capable and accessible (pending acquisition of Hugging Face).

primarySources.title: NVIDIA Corp. Form 8-K Exhibit 99.2 (CFO Commentary: $518B Direct Commitments, $32B Contingent Neocloud, $118B Max Guarantees)
primarySources.verbatimExcerpt: Shipments of Data Center Hopper products to China during the quarter were $2.4 billion. Net gains from equity securities for the third quarter were $1.8 billion, comprised of net gains of $2.8 billion from our publicly held equity securities and a net loss of $1.0 billion from our non-marketable equity securities, including impairment of $1.8 billion. Future commitments by fiscal year as of October 25, 2026: Supply and capacity $390 billion (Remainder of 2027 $69B, 2028 $203B, 2029 $92B, 2030 $10B, 2031 $8B, 2032+ $8B); Cloud service agreements $28 billion; Data center leases not commenced $74 billion; Equity investments $20 billion; Capital expenditures $6 billion; Total $518 billion. Future additional commitments (Neocloud agreements): Total $32 billion (2028 $6B, 2029 $7B, 2030 $6B, 2031 $5B, 2032+ $8B), taking effect only if neoclouds secure financing and capacity is deployed, operational, and accepted by us. Maximum gross exposure related to our guarantees as of October 25, 2026: Land, power, and shell guarantees for neoclouds $3.5 billion; SB Energy Corp. credit support guarantees $105.0 billion; Power and systems credit support guarantees $9.5 billion; Total $118.0 billion. To date, we have not made any payments related to our guarantees. Accounts receivable was $81.0 billion with 64 days sales outstanding (DSO), up from 60 days sequentially, driven by shipment linearity from our Rubin launch and extended payment terms on large, multi-quarter agreements with certain investment-grade customers.

primarySources.title: NVIDIA Corp. Form 8-K Exhibit 99.3 (Supplemental Financial Information for Quarter Ended 2026-10-25)
primarySources.verbatimExcerpt: Balance Sheet as of October 25, 2026: Cash and cash equivalents $29,089M; Marketable debt securities $24,423M; Marketable equity securities $44,219M (plus $4,669M long-term locked-up in Other assets; Level 2 publicly held equity securities $10,516M including unregistered warrants and preferred stock convertible into common stock in public companies; Level 2 convertible debt $3,471M); Accounts receivable, net $81,033M; Inventories $39,724M; Non-marketable securities $65,528M (privately held equity balance $61,650M after $15,431M Q3 net additions and $1,846M Q3 impairments and unrealized losses); Long-term debt $32,371M. Two direct customers accounted for 18% and 17% of our accounts receivable balance as of October 25, 2026. Three direct customers represented 14%, 11%, and 11% of total revenue for the third quarter of fiscal year 2027.

primarySources.title: NVIDIA Investor Presentation Q3 FY27 (17 Slides; Vera Rubin Nearly $20B Q/Q Debut Ramp)
primarySources.verbatimExcerpt: Slide 3 (Revenue): Vera Rubin is off to an extraordinary start, the fastest product ramp in NVIDIA's history. Vera Rubin added nearly $20B in revenue q/q, with strong and diverse contribution across both Hyperscale and ACIE. Returned a record ~$28B to shareholders, while executing strategic investments in R&D, critical supply and capacity, and our ecosystem. NVIDIA compute remains fully utilized. Vera Rubin NVL72 delivered up to 2x the performance per GPU of Blackwell Ultra in its MLPerf Training debut.

primarySources.title: NVIDIA Corp. Form 8-K (Items 1.01 & 2.03: SB Energy PORTS Ohio 4.25 GW / $105B OpenAI Lease Residual Value Guaranties)
primarySources.verbatimExcerpt: Item 1.01 & Item 2.03: On August 17, 2026, NVIDIA Corporation entered into multiple residual value guaranties with SB Energy Corp. relating to 20-year leases for approximately 4.25 gigawatts of IT load at the PORTS Technology Campus in Pike County, Ohio, where an affiliate of OpenAI Group PBC will be the tenant (+3.8 gigawatts optional expansion in NVIDIA's sole discretion). NVIDIA's aggregate payment obligation is cumulatively capped at $105 billion for its initial commitment, subject to ready-for-service conditions expected beginning in 2028 (fiscal 2029). OpenAI has agreed to reimburse and indemnify NVIDIA for any amounts paid.
